children: Mizuho raised its price target on Okta

, the identity security software provider, to $200 from $165 while keeping a Neutral rating, citing momentum in agentic AI and higher comparable multiples. Even after the increase, the target sits about 3% below yesterday's closing price of $205.36, after a 137% year-to-date run.". Okta shares were down 0.76% in premarket.

The call followed Oktane26, Okta's annual user conference in Las Vegas, where management laid out an agentic AI strategy built around Agent SSO, Okta for AI Agents and the Blueprint Alliance. Mizuho said conversations with partners and customers showed encouraging early signs for Okta for AI Agents, though the event produced no landmark announcements.

The firm still sees Okta as a leader in identity and well placed for agentic AI, but said the timing and scale of that opportunity remain unclear. Mizuho also isn't yet convinced Okta can sustain re-accelerated growth over the medium term, which it sees as the likely requirement for the shares to move significantly higher from here.

title: Okta's Oktane Conference Leaves Mizuho Neutral
